critique: The note proves global cubic identification only on the explicitly sign-restricted principal chart and its compact positive box, not on the unrestricted one-proxy LvLiNGAM class. For the published fixed graph it proves generic degree-one identification only after localizing at \(W_2^{\mathrm{el}}\neq0\); the exceptional divisor remains unclassified, so the broader reconciliation of Theorem 3.6 and the promised distinction between genuine ambiguity and removable chart failure are not delivered. The claimed implementation consequence is also only theoretical: neither the released Macaulay2 computation nor a working confidence-set inversion algorithm is reproduced, and the nonconvex feasibility set receives no computational analysis. These scope and reproducibility limitations keep the package below the strongest leading-journal papers despite the delivered identification formula, uniform margins, covariance contrast, and finite-sample coverage theorem.
